clips.title: The story
paras: At Deathknell, a sealed message sends a newly awakened Forsaken rogue to David Trias. Shadow Priest Sarvis passes it on once the recruit has proved ready.

Newly raised Forsaken fight mindless zombies in the cemetery as Deathknell's leaders watch for those drawn to stealth and subterfuge. Once you have proved your readiness, Shadow Priest Sarvis gives promising scouts a sealed parchment. David Trias's discreet seal marks it as an early link to the covert network beneath Forsaken leadership.

David Trias watches Deathknell's crossroads and inn for prospects in future covert operations. The Forsaken need disciplined agents, not common thieves or reckless cutpurses, to serve their fledgling kingdom. Trias says capable rogues may draw the notice of the Shadowstalkers, a Forsaken cadre that prizes cunning, precision, and absolute loyalty to the Dark Lady.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the rogue trainer David Trias. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So you've made it? Good, we'll have need of more rogues as time goes on. The Shadowstalkers will probably wind up finding you when they think the time's right, so don't go and slip up or do anything you might regret. They need talented agents... Not pickpockets and fools.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I spend most of my time here in the inn keeping an eye out for new faces and just keeping tabs on up-and-coming prospects. Keep your nose clean and I'll do what I can to teach you a few things. Just come back to me whenever you want, and we'll see if you're ready for a new skill or two.
